2.200.3
RadialPointer.BarStart
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The RadialPointer.BarStart element specifies where the pointer will start for a RadialPointer if the
radial pointer is of type "Bar". This element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be
a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) or an expression that evaluates to a String. This element is
ignored if the associated RadialPointer.Type is not set to "Bar". The value of the
RadialPointer.BarStart element MUST be one of the following:
ScaleStart: The bar starts from the starting point of the RadialScale.
Zero: The bar starts from the zero point of the RadialScale.
If the RadialPointer.BarStart element is not present, its value is interpreted as "ScaleStart".
The following is the parent element of the RadialPointer.BarStart element.
Parent elements
RadialPointer
The following is the XML Schema definition of the RadialPointer.BarStart element.
 <xsd:element name="BarStart" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
